description: This file contains implementation of classes and methods related to test assembly in the google_breakpad project, including Label, Binding, and Section classes, with functions for handling labels, endianness, and binary data sections.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Represents a label with a value that can be set, offset, or constant, used for referencing positions within binary data.

classes.name: Label::Binding
classes.description: Manages the reference counting and relationships of label values, supporting complex label referencing and offset calculations.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section of binary data with methods to append data, handle endianness, and manage label references.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data or another section to the current section, handling references and contents.

methods.name: LEB128
methods.description: Encodes a signed integer in LEB128 format and appends it to the section.

methods.name: ULEB128
methods.description: Encodes an unsigned integer in ULEB128 format and appends it to the section.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the section's contents to a specified byte boundary, padding with a specified byte.

methods.name: GetContents
methods.description: Resolves label references and outputs the final binary contents of the section.
